description_en: Creates dedicated terminal management invitation codes for one or more users under the current Alibaba Cloud account, generates an eight-digit code for each user, and uniformly specifies the terminal group and validity period
description_zh: 为当前阿里云账号下的一个或多个用户创建专属终端纳管邀请码，每个用户生成一个八位数字码，并统一指定终端分组和有效期
name: CreateUserInvitationCode

parameters.help_en: The logon identifier (EndUserId) of a single user, used for compatibility with single-user creation. You must specify either this parameter or EndUserIds, but not both. If neither is specified, PARAMETER_MISSING is returned. If both are specified, PARAM_ERROR is returned
parameters.help_zh: 单个用户的登录标识（EndUserId），用于兼容单用户创建。与 EndUserIds 二选一，不能同时传入；两者均未传入时返回 PARAMETER_MISSING。同时传入返回 PARAM_ERROR
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The array of user logon identifiers (EndUserIds). You must specify either this parameter or EndUserId. You can specify 1 to 100 unique, non-empty strings at a time, and a code is generated for each user. If any user does not exist, USER_NOT_FOUND is returned. If the array is empty, or contains duplicate items, empty items, or non-string items, PARAM_ERROR is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用户登录标识（EndUserId）数组，与 EndUserId 二选一。一次传入 1～100 个互不重复的非空字符串，每个用户生成一个码。任一用户不存在时返回 USER_NOT_FOUND；空数组、重复项、空项或非字符串项返回 PARAM_ERROR
parameters.name: end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the terminal group. The group must belong to the current account and must not be deleted. After the corresponding terminal uses the management code to complete management, it is added to this group. If the group does not exist, is deleted, or does not belong to the current account, TERMINAL_GROUP_NOT_FOUND is returned
parameters.help_zh: 终端分组 ID。分组必须属于当前账号且未被删除；对应终端使用纳管码完成纳管后加入此分组。分组不存在、已删除或不属于当前账号时返回 TERMINAL_GROUP_NOT_FOUND
parameters.name: terminal_group_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the management code, in minutes. A value of -1 indicates that the code is permanently valid. For values between 60 and 1440, only integer multiples of 60 (1 to 24 hours) are allowed. For values greater than 1440, only integer multiples of 1440 are allowed, up to a maximum of 12960 (2 to 9 days). Other values return PARAM_ERROR. The server calculates the validity period based on this duration
parameters.help_zh: 纳管码有效时长，单位为分钟。-1 表示永久有效；60～1440 之间仅允许 60 的整数倍（1～24 小时）；超过 1440 时仅允许 1440 的整数倍，最大 12960（2～9 天）。其他值返回 PARAM_ERROR。服务端按此时长计算有效期
parameters.name: validity_minutes

schema.description_en: The response for creating management invitation codes
schema.description_zh: 创建纳管邀请码的响应结果

Code.description_en: The business error code. This field may be empty if the call is successful. If the call fails, a value such as PARAM_ERROR indicates that the parameter value is invalid
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。成功时可能为空；失败时例如 PARAM_ERROR 表示参数取值不合法

Data.description_en: The array of created management invitation code records. Each user corresponds to one record. An array is returned even for single-user creation
Data.description_zh: 创建的纳管邀请码记录数组，每个用户对应一条记录；单用户创建也返回数组

BindTime.description_en: The binding time when the terminal uses the code to complete management. This field is empty for a newly created code because it is not yet bound to a terminal
BindTime.description_zh: 终端使用该码完成纳管的绑定时间。新建码尚未绑定终端，此字段为空

EndUserId.description_en: The logon identifier (EndUserId) of the user corresponding to the management code
EndUserId.description_zh: 该纳管码对应的用户登录标识（EndUserId）

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the management code calculated by the server. This field is empty if the code is permanently valid. To determine whether the code has expired, use the Expired field
ExpireTime.description_zh: 服务端计算的纳管码到期时间。永久有效时此字段为空；是否过期请使用 Expired 判断

Expired.description_en: Indicates whether the code has expired as calculated by the server. A value of true indicates that the validity period has expired. A value of false indicates that the code has not expired or is permanently valid. This field is independent of the usage status in the Status field
Expired.description_zh: 服务端计算的是否已过期标记：true 表示有效期已到，false 表示尚未过期或永久有效。与 Status 的使用状态独立

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the management code, generated by the server
GmtCreate.description_zh: 纳管码创建时间，由服务端生成

InvitationCode.description_en: The generated eight-digit terminal management invitation code. It is processed as a string and leading zeros are preserved
InvitationCode.description_zh: 生成的八位数字终端纳管邀请码。按字符串处理并保留前导零

Platform.description_en: The client type of the bound terminal. This field is empty for a newly created code because it is not yet bound to a terminal
Platform.description_zh: 已绑定终端的客户端类型。新建码尚未绑定终端，此字段为空

Status.description_en:
The usage status of the management code. Valid values:
ACTIVE: The code is unused.
USED: The code is used.
The creation response returns ACTIVE. Expiration does not change the usage status. Use the Expired field to determine whether the code has expired
Status.description_zh: 纳管码使用状态：ACTIVE 表示未使用，USED 表示已使用。创建响应为 ACTIVE；过期不会改变使用状态，请使用 Expired 判断

TerminalGroupId.description_en: The ID of the terminal group specified for the management code
TerminalGroupId.description_zh: 该纳管码指定的终端分组 ID

TerminalGroupName.description_en: The display name of the terminal group. This creation operation does not populate this display field, so it may be empty in the creation response
TerminalGroupName.description_zh: 终端分组展示名称。本创建接口不补全该展示字段，创建响应中可能为空

UserName.description_en: The display name of the user. This creation operation does not populate this display field, so it may be empty in the creation response
UserName.description_zh: 用户展示名称。本创建接口不补全该展示字段，创建响应中可能为空

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the terminal that uses the code to complete management. This field is empty for a newly created code because it is not yet bound to a terminal
Uuid.description_zh: 使用该码完成纳管的终端 UUID。新建码尚未绑定终端，此字段为空

ValidityMinutes.description_en: The validity period of the management code, in minutes. The value is the same as the request value. A value of -1 indicates that the code is permanently valid
ValidityMinutes.description_zh: 纳管码有效期，单位为分钟，与请求取值一致；-1 表示永久有效

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the backend business response. A value of 200 indicates success. A value of 400 indicates parameter or business validation failure. A value of 500 indicates a system error
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 后端业务响应的 HTTP 状态码。成功为 200，参数或业务校验失败为 400，系统错误为 500

Message.description_en: The business error message. This field may be empty if the call is successful. If the call fails, this field describes the cause of the error
Message.description_zh: 业务错误信息。成功时可能为空；失败时用于说明错误原因

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, used to locate call logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位调用日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the business processing is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 业务处理是否成功，true 表示成功，false 表示失败
